feature: Configuration State - the real artifacts/portal '/config-state' page (src/pages/config-state.tsx), part of #3002/#1485. Wires GET /api/portal/config-state/{snapshots,snapshots/current,snapshots/:id,changes,changes/:diffId} via configStateLive.ts, per docs/portal/configuration-state-contract-pack.md and the landed 'Configuration State.dc.html' export (#3003). The design's own tenant-specific commentary (workload notes, group notes, history notes) is deliberately NOT copied verbatim - see config-state.tsx's own header comment for why - and is instead derived live from real per-request data (most-common unread reason, largest resource by volume, real notComparableReason breakdowns) via configStateWire.ts's pure helpers.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the full real customer-facing config-state read surface is auth-gated as documented, a logged-in customer gets the real payload shapes configStateLive.ts consumes for the current snapshot, snapshot history, and the change report + attribution roll-up, and a real UI walk confirms the page actually renders one of its real, honest states (never stuck on the pre-auth gate) for a signed-in customer.

AUTH CORE HAS LANDED (#2991, Feature #1648) - login.tsx now ships real #email/#password inputs and a login-submit testid, so this manifest drives a real login instead of only asserting the pre-auth honest empty state (Git #4104 - this note previously said no login page existed yet; that premise was stale, the same correction test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json already made). The page's real state machine (loading/fixture/never-collected/live, config-state.tsx's own `dataState`) is asserted by its literal state-line text rather than a single hardcoded value, since which one is true depends on whether a snapshot has ever been collected for this tenant - a state this manifest does not seed.
There is no ?tenantId= parameter on any of these routes by design (portal-config-state.ts's own header) - scoping is entirely from the JWT customerId claim, so no apiTest attempts to pass one.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build (2026-09-06, session for #3004): BuildConsole's local instance resolves test-manifests/ and UI routes against the dev-server checkout, which does not yet have this page/route merged/deployed (this branch is not yet picked up). Same structural gap #2921's/#2996's/#2998's own manifests document for their uiSteps run. Verified instead by: a real `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass (0 errors) and a real `vite build` (succeeds) against artifacts/portal with this page + route added, plus direct reading of portal-config-state.ts/config-state-views.ts/config-change-attribution.ts confirming the shapes configStateWire.ts/configStateLive.ts assert against. Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once the dev-server merge/restart cycle has picked up this branch.

#2820 (2026-09-12): #3004 wired the diff-level attribution roll-up (verdict counts, CR/risk-decision refs) but `WireChangeRow.attribution` only carried `verdict` and there was no `lifecycle` field at all, so the per-change drill-down (`openChangeGroupPanel`) never rendered the `crRef`/`rbdRef`/`matchScope` or `open`/`resolved`/`reopened` lifecycle status the endpoint already returns per `readDiffChanges()`. Extended `WireChangeRow`/`WireChangeAttribution`/`WireChangeLifecycle` in configStateWire.ts to carry the full real shape, added `buildChangeDetailRows()` (real per-change identity + attribution + lifecycle, replacing the coarser `groupChangesByKind()` grouping which is now dead and removed), and wired `openChangeGroupPanel` in configStateLive.ts to use it. Verified by `tsc --noEmit` (0 errors) + `vite build` (succeeds) against artifacts/portal, and by direct field-for-field comparison against `lib/db/src/schema/config-attribution.ts` and `readDiffChanges()` in config-state-views.ts. NOT verified against live data: this worktree's local Postgres has zero rows in `config_diffs`/`config_diff_changes`/`config_change_attributions`/`config_change_lifecycle` (checked directly) - no snapshot has ever been collected locally, so there is no real diff to exercise end-to-end, the same real gap #3004 hit. No new apiTest/uiStep added for this specific enhancement given no live diff data exists locally to assert against without fabricating one; the existing CHANGES-1/2 apiTests already cover the endpoint's real 200 shape.

Git #4104 (2026-09-14): this manifest's real loginAs + authenticated-uiSteps rewrite was validated indirectly rather than by directly invoking shaneapp://runTest against THIS file - BuildConsole's dev-server checkout still resolves the pre-#4104 file (the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/team-management.json's own #4104 note documents with direct live evidence). Instead, the identical pattern (top-level loginAs, goto the real route, expect a real data-testid) was verified live against test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json - an already-merged sibling using this exact mechanism - via a real shaneapp://runTest invocation from this build session: real login succeeded, the real goto navigated correctly, and the real testid-based expect assertions ([data-testid='risk-row-toggle-RBD-2026-104'], [data-testid='policy-decision-row-RBD-2026-104']) genuinely passed in this live BuildConsole/WebView2 environment (18/21 steps passed; the 3 failures are pre-existing content-drift already in that file, unrelated to and not touched by this build). Re-run this manifest directly via shaneapp://runTest once this branch merges to the dev-server checkout.
